g.text: FR3 5-D pose: FMPE error against model size

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c5967

g.text: Lower Err_post and higher success are better
Test set, 1,000 poses x 1,000 samples, FMPE alpha = 1, Euler x 64 (64 NFE), seed 0, 50 epochs at every size. Validation-loss log-log slopes, epochs 30-50: 0.3M -0.063, 1.0M
-0.076, 3.0M -0.088. Every size was still improving at epoch 50, so this compares models at a fixed training budget, not at convergence. Circled: the 3M headline run. Grey
band: oracle Err_post ± 5e-4; its lower edge is below zero and is cut off by the log axis.
